main_text.p: quas comburunt fœminæ ( velut & ipfas puerperarum fecundinas folent,) nihil damni fœminæ afferunt? cur primus menftruus fanguis combuftus virgini noceat, non reliquus? Certè author fim ego, ut fi quis adeò fuis metuat excrementis, ea in capfulam includat, eademque in loco tutiffimo aflervet, vel in finum recondat. Sed dicam cum Papinio, quid plura moror? fcopum aflecutus videor. Solidè, ni fallor, ftendi, Sympathetico Pulveri maleficii fufpicionem nequaquam ademptam, nec ad naturalem caufam ejus virtutem reduƈtam. Sed tandem ad Illuftr. D. Digbæum me confero.

page.notes: The first word of the page is "quas" (continuation). Possible reading "author" for the printed "auctor" was transcribed as printed; "ftendi" in the source is "oftendi" with the initial letter partly lost, and the italic "Papinio" line is treated as a proper name. Marginal and catchword areas are empty.
